refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.description: Money going back to guests. The counter asks and you decide.

waiting.title: Nothing is waiting

writeOffs.title: Write-offs
writeOffs.description: Balances nobody will chase any more. The counter asks and you decide.

consequence.owes: The guest will owe {amount} after this.

waiting.title: Nothing is waiting

rejected.title: Nothing rejected
rejected.body: Requests you reject, or that the counter takes back, are listed here.

filtered.body: Try a different search, or clear the filters.

detail.missing: We can't find this request. It may belong to another venue.

detail.decisionWithdrawn: The counter took this request back.
